image_query: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple gold gopuram Ananda Nilayam vimana
tweets: Atop Tirumala's Seven Hills, the sanctum of Śrī Veṅkaṭeśvara wears a vimāna sheathed in gold — the Ānanda Nilayam. At its entrance stand gold images of Kṛṣṇadevarāya and his queens, cast after the Vijayanagara emperor's pilgrimages here, 1513–1521.
